column1: Eleven target-focused plain MLPs, each with 90% target / 1% per auxiliary loss. Uniform and 100%-target controls share all eleven heads, initialization, balanced batches and settings. One shared best checkpoint per fit; full encoder fine-tuning; no new task attention. Five seeds on the frozen complete-IL split. Prespecified 200-epoch cap for all new arms, patience 15. Historical 100-epoch single-task and all-task-selected MTL are contextual references. Tabular primary comparator: lowest five-seed validation standardized MSE across all six configurations. Lowest historical five-seed test MAE is a separate descriptive benchmark, never a deployment nomination. No best-seed selection. Native CO2 MAE, ln-viscosity MAE; preserve both target spaces. Previously inspected test split: exploratory comparison, not independent confirmation.
Each new fit selects and early-stops on its target validation standardized MSE only.
New target-only control retains all heads and identical balanced sampling; zero auxiliary losses. It is not an MoE.
Five-seed means are mean errors of five models, not errors of an ensemble predictor. Partial-seed values never enter the comparison figure.
Paired intervals: 5000 whole-IL resamples of seed-averaged absolute-error differences, conditional on fitted models. Negative delta favors the specialist.
Sign randomization: 10000 whole-IL sign draws. BH over 66 tests (11 tasks x 3 controls x 2 weightings), only after all production fits complete.
Tabular observed test minimum selects among six configurations by mean test MAE, not best seed; descriptive only, no associated significance claim.
All task errors, including auxiliary losses, are retained in Per_seed; compare only target==task for the specialist portfolio.
Original low-precision tabular values are restored in memory only when four archived metrics agree; original files remain untouched.
Repeated test inspection, one chemical split, few held-out ILs and unverified Cp source units limit generalization claims.
